entities.name: Fern Hobbs
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fern Hobbs was an American attorney in the U.S. state of Oregon, and private secretary to Oregon Governor Oswald West. She was noted for her ambition and several accomplishments as a young woman, and became the highest-paid woman in public service in America in her mid-twenties.
